dependencyBoundary: Stitch ZIP is reference-only; no runtime/build/test dependency.

webcodecs.productionClaim: only after codec support probe passes

wasm.productionClaim: WASM engine is not claimed until an actual engine/module is present

acceleration.serverFallback: internal ffmpeg remains authoritative server render fallback

print.comicPdfx4: print-pipeline capability only; actual PDF/X-4 certification requires runtime output validation

renderTargets.note: Stitch evidence used as capability requirement/reference; actual renderer acceptance requires current runtime evidence.

browserAcceleration.webgpu: probe adapter and device capability; never infer renderer readiness from API existence
browserAcceleration.webcodecs: probe isConfigSupported for target codec configuration
browserAcceleration.wasm: probe WebAssembly execution; engine readiness requires actual KV30 module

audioProduction.sidechainDucking: supported as project metadata; actual DSP engine evidence required

comicPrint.rip: Ghostscript availability is detected; RIP certification requires validated output and print-profile evidence

runtimeAcceptance.fourK60: actual internal FFmpeg fallback acceptance test
runtimeAcceptance.nvdec: actual NVIDIA decoder runtime required; capability listing alone is insufficient
runtimeAcceptance.pdfx4: generated output plus structural/profile validation required
runtimeAcceptance.neuralModel: installed model plus successful KV30 inference required
